get.description: Get the list of all available roles.

200.description: Returns an array containing information about each role

row.name: View
row.description: A user with this role can view all reports.

row.name: Write
row.description: Users with this role can view all content plus create, manage and delete entities such as Goals, Funnels, Heatmaps, Session Recordings and Forms for this website.

row.name: Admin
row.description: Users with this role can manage a website and give other users access to the website. They can also do everything the Write role can do.

parameters.description: Access to grant. Must have one of the following value : noaccess, view, write, admin. May also be an array to sent additional capabilities

parameters.description: The array of idSites on which to apply the access level for the user. If the value is "all" then we apply the access level to all the websites ID for which the current authentificated user has an 'admin' access.

get.description: Generates an app specific API token every time you call this method. You should ideally store this token securely in your app and not generate a new token every time.

parameters.name: userLogin
parameters.description: Login or Email address

parameters.name: passwordConfirmation
parameters.description: the current user's password. For security purposes, this value should be sent as a POST parameter.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description for this app specific password, for example your app name. Max 100 characters are allowed

parameters.name: expireDate
parameters.description: Optionally a date when the token should expire

parameters.name: expireHours
parameters.description: Optionally number of hours for how long the token should be valid before it expires. If expireDate is set and expireHours, then expireDate will be used. If expireDate is set and expireHours, then expireDate will be used.

parameters.name: secureOnly
parameters.description: Defines if the token can be used securely only (if true, token can't be provided as param in GET requests)

tags.name: UsersManager
tags.description: The UsersManager API lets you Manage Users and their permissions to access specific websites. You can create users via "addUser", update existing users via "updateUser" and delete users via "deleteUser". There are many ways to list users based on their login "getUser" and "getUsers", their email "getUserByEmail", or which users have permission (view or admin) to access the specified websites "getUsersWithSiteAccess". Existing Permissions are listed given a login via "getSitesAccessFromUser", or a website ID via "getUsersAccessFromSite", or you can list all users and websites for a given permission via "getUsersSitesFromAccess". Permissions are set and updated via the method "setUserAccess". See also the documentation about Managing Users in Matomo.
